'''August 2000 Lakewood tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Coach's Corner Collectibles, Lakewood, WA on 18 August 2000. [[Douglas Harvilla]] won it. It is known from Douglas Harvilla's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1145">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-lakewood-wa-8-18-00d1145/ lakewood-wa-8-18-00], DeckTech (Douglas "Douglas" Harvilla, 19 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-19-lakewood-wa-8-18-00d1145/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 August 2000
* '''Site:''' Coach's Corner Collectibles, Lakewood, WA
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[Douglas Harvilla]]
